propositions: The code-review project criteria runtime contract lacks authoritative normative documentation in docs/llm-framework.md, creating risk of silent regression or misstatement across fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval resolution, and CLI admission.
Project LLM criteria must be injected exactly once into round_a and never injected into round_b, whose membership remains escalation/overlay-controlled.
The repository-scoped effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for logical project ids in Pass 3.
Project code-review ids must resolve through criteria eval only if active in exactly one gate; unknown and cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration.
Activated project criteria with missing or invalid prompt/eval specifications must raise located configuration errors rather than silently falling back.
